name: Voice213
original_description:
Voice213 brings natural Algerian, Tunisian and Libyan darija voice-overs, and AI voice agents for your business, into ChatGPT. Connect your Voice213 account, then ask in plain words.

What you can do:
- Turn a script into an MP3 voice-over with a darija voice, on five voice models from Lite to Pro 2. Tone directions such as (نبرة حماسية) change how a line is performed.
- Write ad scripts in darija, add tashkeel and tone directions to a script, and transcribe recordings.
- Design a new custom voice from a description, and keep the one you like.
- Create, teach, test and publish voice agents that answer your customers' calls and chats on your website and WhatsApp, and read their conversations.
- Create landing pages and product photos for your products.
- Find your past voice-overs and creations, and check your Voice213 account.

You need a Voice213 account. You can disconnect ChatGPT at any time in Voice213, under Settings → Security → Connected apps.
